comment: The four INTERVAL sliders are params 7, 6, 5 and 4 from left to right, the four THEME sliders params 3, 2, 1 and 0; both groups are numbered right to left. The leftmost INTERVAL slider is the note's least significant bit. The panel's slider scale is OFF, ON, C 1/2, C1, C2, C4, C8, C3, C6 and then B1 to B31, which is slider value 39 down to 0. The lamp beside the OFF position is never lit: the light loop stops at 39 of the 40 lamps.
